{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Verify the number of rows after dropping
print('Number of rows after dropping missing values:', len(df_clean))

# Compute Pearson correlation and print the result directly
correlation = df_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(df_clean['body_mass_g'])
print('Pearson correlation:', correlation)"}
